attributes.residual:
BEST RETAINED = BASELINE, unchanged: real 26, insns T57/O57, multiset 2t (target-only +1 addi, ours-only -1 mr), fuzzy 86.49%.

MECHANISM, fully named. The target forms the `lbl_801131C0` address in TWO halves straddling the prologue: `lis r3,@ha` at 0x0c BEFORE `stwu`/`stmw`, then `addi r31,r3,@lo` at 0x20 AFTER `stmw`, holding it in callee-saved r31 for the whole function, and pays one `addi r3,r31,0` copy at the single use. Our baseline instead forms the entire address at the point of use: `lis r3,@ha / addi r0,r3,@lo / mr r3,r0` -- the same THREE words, but the third is spelled `mr` instead of `addi`. So at baseline the residual is exactly one copy-form word plus register colour.

WHY BOTH PROBES FAILED, stated as the next agent needs it: initialising at the declaration DOES hoist the address as intended, but MWCC completes the `@lo` half into r0 BEFORE `stmw` runs (measured: `addi r0,r3,@lo` at 0x0c, `stmw` at 0x20, then `mr r30,r0` at 0x28), so the surplus `mr` simply MIGRATES from the use site to the prologue and the function grows to 58 instructions. The target completes BOTH `@lo` halves after `stmw`. Neither declaration order changes this, and probe 2 proved decl order does not even move the colours (ours keeps opts=r31/st=r30 against target's opts=r30/st=r31 in both spellings).

RECLASSIFICATION. The prior record attempt.check-prefs-loaded-point-of-use.20260830.v1 concluded 'residual now pure REGISTER_ONLY ... no decl-order signal left to test'. That label is REFUTED by fresh measurement: `--ops` reports multiset DIFFERS (+1 addi / -1 mr), i.e. a copy-FORM difference, not a pure recolor. The correct class is the served equivalent_copy_form + recolor class (the same family the TU's own attempt.CN_memcardcreategaunt-composed-close.20260901.v1 composed successfully), so the next move is the WebFrank audit, not another source probe. Two source axes are now measured dead and must not be respelled.
